Explorations are interactive essays on the site: one idea at a time, with
equations, timing diagrams and live circuits the reader can manipulate
(VISION.md sections 1 and 4).

## Purpose

Active learning (VISION.md section 2): the reader predicts, manipulates and
checks, instead of reading a static picture of a dynamic thing.

## Which modules it uses

- Today: the site's Quarto setup (MathJax 4 with STIX Two maths, IEEE figure
  and equation numbering), plus WaveDrom timing diagrams and DigitalJS
  circuits as an interim (VISION.md section 9).
- Planned: the circuit schema, the symbol pack and the suite's own web tools,
  so every figure on a page comes from the same source.

## Status

`explorations/kmaps/` is a feature template, not a finished exploration. The
first flagship exploration, the 4-bit ripple-carry adder as a figure, an
animation and a browser interactive from one schema file, is the first
target of Phase 1 (VISION.md section 6).

## Where to start

To write an exploration, copy `explorations/kmaps/` and follow the comments
in its `index.qmd`. Every exploration page is published by URL only and
marked `noindex` until the site launches.
